principal.title: Message from the Principal
principal.lead: Welcome to Highlight Model School, Saraghundi Thall — an educational home dedicated to moral discipline, scholastic rigor, and intellectual discovery.
principal.p1: At Highlight Model School, our sacred mission is to guide young students from their foundational early years up through high school matriculation with an unwavering commitment to quality. We blend the official KPK curriculum with modern STEM learning, biometric discipline, and moral mentorship so that our children grow to be leaders of their community and nation.
principal.p2: Our doors are open to every parent striving for a brighter, honorable future for their son and daughter. We welcome you to visit our campus in Saraghundi Thall and join the Highlight family.

about.title: About Our School
about.lead: Highlight Model School delivers a holistic learning journey rooted in moral integrity, Islamic values, and scientific curiosity. We nurture a disciplined educational atmosphere in Saraghundi Thall where students flourish into responsible citizens.
about.introText: Serving the children of Saraghundi Thall and District Hangu with modern classrooms, dedicated faculty, science laboratories, computer literacy, and automated student attendance tracking.
about.missionText: To empower every student with academic mastery, moral clarity, disciplined habits, and critical thinking skills essential for higher educational achievement and community uplift.
about.visionText: To be celebrated as the premier regional center of scholastic distinction, developing ethical thinkers and resilient leaders who honorably contribute to society under the banner of 'نور • ہدایت • حکمت'.

programs.title: Pre-Primary Wing

programs.title: Middle Wing

announcements.title: Admissions Open for Academic Session 2026-2027
announcements.description: Admissions are officially open from Playgroup to Matric (Grade 10). Limited seats are available on merit. Prospectus and admission forms are obtainable from the main campus admission desk or online.

announcements.title: Parent-Teacher Meeting (PTM) & Term Progress Reports
announcements.description: The quarterly Parent-Teacher Meeting will be held on the upcoming Saturday from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM. Parents are warmly encouraged to discuss their child's academic and moral progress.

announcements.title: Launch of Smart Biometric Attendance & Parent Portal Sync
announcements.description: We are pleased to announce the complete rollout of automated fingerprint biometric attendance. Daily entry and exit alerts are now synchronized in real-time with the HMS Parent Portal.
